name: focus-ring
summary: Draws a keyboard focus ring with outline on :focus-visible, which survives forced-colors mode where a box-shadow ring disappears.

arguments.name: $offset
accepts: a length; negative draws the ring inside the element

arguments.name: $color
accepts: a colour, currentColor, a system colour such as Highlight, or a function such as var() or color-mix()
a word that is not a colour, a quoted colour, a length and a CSS-wide keyword are refused, because the outline would be dropped
